title: 解码载荷驻留内存
title_en: Lossless Cache Replacement Decoded Payload Cache

standard.summary: 将解码后的 latent 载荷驻留在 CPU 内存，减少重复磁盘 IO
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Keeps the decoded latent payload resident in CPU memory, cutting repeated disk IO
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 将解码后的 latent 载荷驻留在 CPU 内存，减少重复磁盘 IO（data-bound 场景有效）。

advanced_en.principle: Resident-decodes latent payloads in CPU memory, reducing repeated disk IO (effective in data-bound scenarios).
